class.name: Vst3InstrumentOutput
class.brief_description: One of a [Vst3Instrument]'s outputs beyond the main one, as an audio stream.
class.description: Made by [method Vst3Instrument.get_output] (and [method Vst3Instrument.bind_outputs]). Play it in a player of its own, on any bus: it sounds that output of the instrument's plugin, in step with the others.

method.name: get_index
method.description: Which output: 1 and up (0, the main output, is the instrument itself).

method.name: get_instrument
method.description: The instrument this is an output of.
